metadata.description: Read-only MCP server for InSync Healthcare (Qualifacts) patient portals — appointments, medications, allergies, messages, forms and balance. Signs in server-side with the portal password, or relays requests through the user's signed-in browser tab via the ContextMint Bridge extension.

plugins.name: insync-mcp
plugins.description: Read an InSync Healthcare (Qualifacts) patient portal — appointments, medications, allergies, messages, forms, balance — by signing in server-side or relaying through the user's signed-in browser tab.
